# Nesso

> Free iPhone app that helps people in their teens and 20s stay in touch with friends and family. Smart reminders, AI-drafted messages, and an iMessage extension. Built by Brady Schwartz.

Nesso is a friendship-maintenance app. Core features: per-person reminder cadence, AI message drafts that match your typing style, an iMessage extension so check-ins happen without app-switching, streaks tied to actual reach-outs (not opening the app), and a snooze that pauses reminders without guilt.

## Long-form guides

- [How to Stay in Touch With Friends (2026 guide)](https://nesso.tech/guide/stay-in-touch-with-friends.html): science-backed cadence rules, message templates, and a comparison of friendship-maintenance apps. Written by Brady Schwartz.

## Author

Brady Schwartz, founder of Nesso. Solo developer, 18, USC-bound for AI. Started the app at 17 after losing touch with most of his high-school friends within a year of college start. Reach: brady@nesso.tech.
